raw.description:
Create a new ad campaign on any supported platform. SAFETY: dry_run defaults to true — always preview the payload before executing. Campaigns are ALWAYS created in PAUSED status regardless of input. Use publish_campaign to activate. Before calling create_campaign, first run plan_campaign_structure for supported generic platforms so the MCP inspects workspace assets, recent campaign patterns, and likely structure. Set idempotency_key (UUID) to prevent duplicate creation on retries. You can pass source_campaign_id plus autofill_from_history=true to reuse safe defaults from a historical campaign snapshot. Meta, Snapchat, and TikTok campaign launch is native-only on MCP; use meta_*, snapchat_*, and tiktok_* native create/update/report tools. 

Objective values by platform:
  X: REACH, ENGAGEMENTS, WEBSITE_CLICKS, VIDEO_VIEWS, APP_INSTALLS, WEBSITE_CONVERSIONS, APP_ENGAGEMENTS, FOLLOWERS, PREROLL_VIEWS. X app line-item goals include APP_CLICKS, APP_INSTALLS, and APP_PURCHASES.
  DV360: AWARENESS, TRAFFIC, SALES, LEADS, APP_INSTALLS, VIDEO, DEMAND_GEN

Budget units: USD for DV360 campaign planned spend only; serving budget is set on insertion orders and line items.
DV360 note: create_campaign creates the paused campaign shell only. Create insertion orders with dv360_native_action DV360_ADVERTISERS_INSERTION_ORDERS_CREATE, line items with create_adset or DV360_ADVERTISERS_LINE_ITEMS_CREATE, then upload/create/assign creatives before activation.
Requires scope: write:campaigns.

raw.description: Transfer a campaign from one advertising platform to another using the same Whathead cross-transfer workflow as the main system. The backend fetches the full source tree (campaign, ad sets, ads), maps entities to the destination platform, migrates media first, then creates destination campaign/ad sets/ads in the requested safe execution mode. Supports Builder-equivalent partial transfers (campaign-only, selected ad sets, selected ads), multi-asset expansion, and destination-side field overrides such as objective or budget before publish. Production-safe flow: dry_run defaults to true for preview; when dry_run is false the backend rebuilds the current migration plan inline and executes only if the plan is ready. Meta to Snapchat/TikTok guardrail: only story-compatible vertical assets are uploaded; ads without a compatible vertical asset are flagged and skipped instead of forcing a bad 1:1 or landscape creative. SAFETY: dry_run defaults to true. dry_run=false with execution_mode=create_paused creates destination entities paused; no separate migration_plan_id or confirmed flag is required. Supported production platforms are Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, and Google. Google is supported as a transfer target (Search/Display/Video/Demand Gen via the standard tree; Performance Max via the asset-group orchestrator). Do not use this tool for DV360, Adjust, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, or OpenAI Ads until a platform-specific mapper exists. Use destination_credentials when the destination platform needs page/profile/identity context for ad creation, such as Meta Page, Snapchat Public Profile, or TikTok Identity. Requires scope: write:campaigns.

raw.description: Unified upload parity tool for both the legacy direct platform upload routes and the system-backed creative-assets upload flow. Use UPLOAD_LOCAL_FILE or UPLOAD_FROM_URL_VIA_SESSION when you want the same storage + Inngest + creative_assets lineage used by the main app. GET_SIGNED_URL / CONFIRM_UPLOAD and direct UPLOAD_FROM_URL remain available for low-level parity workflows. Storage-backed upload sessions support Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, google, openai, x (Twitter Ads), reddit, linkedin, DV360, and Criteo targets. Direct UPLOAD_FROM_URL uses the platform upload adapter where available. Google images are registered through Google Ads AssetService and return uploaded_asset / google_asset_resource_name; Google videos require a YouTube URL or 11-character video ID and return a YouTube video asset. DV360 uploads use dv360_native_action because they require advertiser-scoped DV360 asset/adAsset endpoints. For X, the call returns x_media_key — bind it to a tweet via x_creative_ops CREATE_TWEET (with media_keys) before promoting. After upload/import completes, call list_media_assets to pick up the final platform-specific IDs used by create payloads. dry_run defaults to true for mutating upload flows.

raw.description:
Update a campaign, ad set, or ad on any platform. SAFETY: dry_run defaults to true — always preview the diff before executing. Immutable fields are automatically blocked with workaround instructions. Read the field-rules resource before calling to know which fields are editable. When an upstream validation error mentions a missing parent context or unsupported field combination, re-check platform-capabilities and the platform’s official docs before retrying; do not blindly repeat the same payload. Meta, Snapchat, and TikTok updates are native-only on MCP; use their native update/status tools. 

Common editable fields:
  Campaign: name, status, daily_budget, lifetime_budget, bid_strategy
  Ad Set: name, status, targeting, bid_amount, daily_budget, end_time
  Ad: name, status, creative

Status values: Google uses ENABLED/PAUSED. Meta, Snapchat, and TikTok status updates are native-only.
Requires scope: write:campaigns.

platform.description: The advertising platform. Meta, Snapchat, and TikTok are native-only; use native update tools.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity to update

updates.description: Fields to update as key-value pairs. Only include fields you want to change. Use platform-native field names for supported generic platforms, or shared compiler form-style fields when payload_mode="form".

payload_mode.description: Optional override. Use "api" for direct platform-native update fields. Use "form" on Reddit, OpenAI, Google, X, or LinkedIn to merge the requested form changes with the current entity and compile the final update payload through the shared platform compiler. When omitted, raw API mode is used. Set payload_mode="form" explicitly when you want compiler-backed merge/update behavior.

compiler_context.description: Optional extra form context used when payload_mode="form"

dry_run.description: Return a request preview without updating the saved query
